facts.fact: Lei n.º 22/11 arts. 44-45 create the Agência de Protecção de Dados as a public-law body with administrative and financial autonomy and seven members (three named by the President, three elected by the National Assembly, one judge), its organisation to be set by executive decree; the law itself does not constitute it.
